mode: Built-in, reference-guided generation of two distinct static concept compositions

reference.role: User-approved art direction and cyan hero reference

visualReview.method: Direct inspection of both native generated images
findings: Image 1 shows a compact lander on the left and a continuous organic slope into the cave on the right.
Image 2 shows a cyan miner at an embedded vein and an orange teammate carrying a mineral toward the left.
Both preserve the hand-inked style, warm rock, cool layered recesses, moss and mushrooms.
Working surfaces and thick foreground rock remain visible; no square stair grid.
The second cascade is placed on the left, leaving the main mining focus on the right.
limitations: These are static concept paintings, not animated assets or a modular tile atlas.
Character and tool are AI redrawings; neither original sprite identity nor exact tool reach is certified.
Some warm floor edging remains continuous and some ore appears in the illustrated front rock face; these are art-direction choices, not runtime visibility rules.
Slope masks, common edges, collision and WFC rules are not produced or validated by these illustrations.

scope: Art-only concept slice; no production assets, code, Unity, gameplay or dependency changes.
